## Download

Scroll down to **Assets** and download the file for your computer:

| You have | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | `EmberlineSpectralis-<version>-windows-setup.exe` (installer), or `EmberlineSpectralis-windows.zip` |
| **Mac** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `EmberlineSpectralis-<version>-macos.pkg` (installer), or `EmberlineSpectralis-macos.zip` |
| **Linux** (x86_64) | `emberline-spectralis_<version>_amd64.deb` (Debian / Ubuntu / Mint), or `EmberlineSpectralis-linux.tar.gz` (any distro, no root) |

Ignore **Source code (zip)** and **Source code (tar.gz)** - those are for developers.

Run the installer, then rescan plugins in your DAW. Every download contains both the plugin (VST3, for your DAW) and a Standalone app. The zips and tar.gz include an `INSTALL.txt` for manual installs.

Windows code signing is planned through [SignPath.io](https://signpath.io) with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org) once the project qualifies ([policy](https://github.com/ljw46/EmberlineSpectralis/blob/main/CODE_SIGNING_POLICY.md)). Until then, the installers aren't code-signed, so Windows may show a SmartScreen warning (More info, then Run anyway) and macOS may say the developer can't be verified (right-click the file, then Open). INSTALL.txt explains both.

**Manual:** open the plugin and click the **?** button next to the preset bar. Found a bug? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/ljw46/EmberlineSpectralis/issues) with your DAW, operating system and the version shown under the preset bar.

Enjoying it? [Buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/emberlinesky).
